title: 第43章 群臣要迁都
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 此时炎文帝和狄苍都很激动。北狄三十万大军压境，东虞三十万大军策应，那得是多大的危机？弄不好可不仅仅是丢失北境，而是灭国！但这样的危机，就这样被眼前的少年三言两句给破了。虽然他提供的只是思路，但有思路就够了。至于细节……细节有一群阴谋家帮他补充。炎文帝虽然对朝中那群大臣不抱太大的希望，但玩阴谋阴阳人这种事，他们的确是一把手。只是现在听到狄苍这老东西提起唐画，炎文帝的好心情顿时就没有了。扫兴，没事提那只会阿谀奉承的蠢货做什么。炎文帝很清楚，唐画今天这一出，显然就是在交投名状。他爹是丞相一党，他交投名状也无可厚非，但炎文帝就是很不爽，你一个新科状元，难道不该先向朕表忠心吗？“唐画，就是你那个兄长，人不怎么样，才华是真不错。”想到那首《劝谏诗》，炎文帝虽然不满，但还是由衷觉得不错。就是感觉诗词中所表达的意思，似乎被曲解了。“今日殿试，他一首《劝谏诗》，差点让……陛下下不来台。”炎文帝脸色有些阴翳，道：“如果不是因为你指认的间谍，以及东境的八百里加急，今日在资政殿，恐怕真得闹翻天了。”当然，现在想翻天的是朕。那群叫嚣的家伙能想出退敌之策还好说，想不出退敌之策，哼，看朕回去怎么收拾他们。唐逸闻言愣了一下，随即也只是笑了笑，并不在意。看到他的样子，狄苍手拍着他的肩膀道：“小子，那家伙得了状元，怎么感觉你一点都不在意啊？”唐逸耸耸肩，道：“没什么可在意的，唐画得唐敬真传，又是科举第一，殿试被钦点为状元，很正常。”“好吧，还是有点在意的，可以说说他写的什么诗吗？”唐逸还是觉得得看看唐画是什么水平。万一几天后的沈园诗会，题目和前世那些大佬的诗词都不搭边，到时候没得抄，那就扯淡了。狄苍看向炎文帝，陛下你来说吧，我不会背……“平时让你多看点书，你还说是朕为难你。”炎文帝瞪了狄苍一眼，看向唐逸道：“国破山河在，城春草木深，感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心……”“等等，你说这首诗是唐画写的？”炎文帝话没说完，唐逸已经惊得站了起来。我特妈！这是杜甫的《春望》吧？《春望》怎么就成了唐画的《劝谏诗》了？难不成这家伙也是穿越者？这个念头刚冒出来，立马就被唐逸自己给否决了。要是穿越者还是唐画这尿性，那简直丢穿越者的脸。那这首诗，只可能是他偷的。昨晚他被梁绍他们叫出去的时候，唐画就在院中，而当时他刚好将送给老王爷的这首《春望》，给写了下来。应该是他们离开后，唐画潜入了屋中，将这首诗给拿走了。然后，这首诗就被唐画当成自己的用了，在殿试上夺魁。无耻啊！“怎么样？吓到了吧？告诉你，在大殿上的时候，所有人都吓到了。”炎文帝想到当时的那个场景，摇了摇头道：“那群文官自以为有了代言人，笑声差点没把资政殿给震塌陷了。”唐逸嘴角微微抽搐。我不是这个意思，我是想说唐画是抄的。这首诗我已经送给了老王爷，现在成为老王爷的专属了。《春望》？呵，当日离开的时候，老王爷连诗的名字都改了。名字就叫《老福王忆靖康耻》。这等老福王巡查回来，他的专属BGM被人给偷了，以那老头的性格还不得爆炸？就是不知道到时候事情闹大了，会不会牵连到他和唐音。唐逸看向炎文帝，几次想要开口说出真相，但还是忍住了。现在说出来，有种妒贤嫉能的感觉，炎文帝和狄老将军信不信还两说，关键是……连他也是抄的！只是他抄没人知道。唐画抄了会出大事情。“好了，唐逸，别那么在意，你写的《满江红》和《破阵子》，不逊色于《劝谏诗》……”炎文帝怕唐逸想不开，笑着安慰。话落，他嘴角笑容渐渐收敛。“不提这件事了，有件事得告诉你，不过你不要激动。”“唐音受伤了，遍体鳞伤……”哐当！他话没说完，唐逸已经猛地站了起来，身后的椅子都被掀翻在地。听到这动静，守在门外的陈貂寺和赵虎几乎瞬间破门而入，齐齐护在炎文帝的身前。赵虎手中的剑，更是瞬间出了鞘。此时的唐逸，脸色阴沉，双眸凛冽，那全身弥漫的杀意，几乎化成了实质。冰冷而强势的压迫感扑面而来。“谁干的？我妹妹不是在梁家吗？”唐逸声音寒冰彻骨。炎文帝和狄苍都被唐逸此时的气势所震慑到。这种气势，一般只有百战悍将身上才有。但现在，他们却从眼前这少年的身上感受到了。一个连府邸都没出过的少年，上哪里去练这份杀气？“是唐浩和林竹干的，把我的玉佩也顺走了，真是好大的胆子……”炎文帝也是脸色冷冽，先是抢他给唐逸的银票，再是抢他给音音得玉佩，唐家人还真是狗胆包天。要不是不好干涉唐家内宅事，也没到在唐逸面前暴露身份的时候，他非得让唐家人知道冒犯天威的后果！“唐音现在没事，昨日贤妃娘娘刚好在梁家，将她带回宫照顾了。”炎文帝挥手让陈貂寺和赵虎退开，道：“你去皇宫等吧，我们回去让人通知一下宫里，把唐音送出来。”“那孩子很懂事，在极力伪装，事情你解决，解决不了，贤妃帮你解决。”“至于音儿那里，你就当作什么都不知道就好。”唐逸身体猛地颤了颤，心头像是挨了重重一刀，很疼。有痕迹的！昨天晚上他明明发现唐音失去了白天的活力，变得胆小恐惧。可是，他还以为是因为梁绍一群人的到来，让她害怕了。唐逸自责得想要给自己两巴掌。“萧叔，我和你们一起进宫。”唐逸眼睛红了，道：“我去宫外接她，不见到她我不放心。”炎文帝同意了。一群人出了酒楼上了马车，马车便向着皇宫驶去。……皇宫，资政殿。此时，议论争吵了半天的一众大臣，没想什么退敌之策，而是已经想好了退路。迁都！既然北狄和东虞联合，总共六十万大军攻打北境，挡是肯定挡不住了的。一旦北狄和东虞大军合兵一处，突破大炎最后的堡垒墉城关，不出三天北狄的骑兵就会出现在京都城外。那现在唯一的办法，就是迁都。先把大炎国都迁到南方，远离北狄和东虞联军的攻击范围，再争取更多的时间来逃命……不对，是来布局！完美！
content_en: At this time, Emperor Yanwen and Di Cang were very excited.Beidi's 300,000-strong army is pressing down on the border, and Dongyu's 300,000-strong army is supporting it. How big of a crisis is that?If it fails, it will not only be the loss of the northern territory, but also the destruction of the country!But such a crisis was broken by a few words from the young man in front of him.Although he only provides ideas, having ideas is enough.As for the details... a group of conspirators helped him fill in the details.Although Emperor Yanwen didn't have much hope for the ministers in the court, they were indeed the top leaders in the conspiracy.But now that he heard the old man Di Cang mention Tang paintings, Emperor Yanwen's good mood suddenly disappeared.It's a bummer, there's nothing to say about what that sycophantic idiot is doing.Emperor Yanwen knew very well that Tang Hua's appearance today was obviously an exchange of titles.His father was a member of the prime minister's party, so it was understandable that he surrendered his title, but Emperor Yanwen was very unhappy. You are a new champion, shouldn't you show your loyalty to me first?"Tang Hua is that brother of yours. He is not a good person, but he is very talented." Thinking of the "Poetry of Admonition", Emperor Yan Wen, although dissatisfied, still felt that it was good.It just feels like the meaning expressed in the poem seems to have been misinterpreted."In today's palace examination, his "Poetry of Remonstrance" almost made...His Majesty not come to the stage." Emperor Yanwen's face was a little gloomy, and he said: "If it weren't for the spy you identified and the eight hundred miles to the east, there would have been a real uproar in the Zizheng Palace today." Of course, I am the one who wants to make trouble now.That group of clamoring guys can think of a way to retreat from the enemy, but if they can't think of a way to retreat from the enemy, well, let's see how I deal with them when I get back.Tang Yi was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and then he just smiled and didn't care.Seeing his appearance, Di Cang patted his shoulder and said, "Boy, that guy won the top prize. Why do you feel like you don't care at all?" Tang Yi shrugged and said, "It's nothing to care about. Tang Hua is a true biography of Tang Jing, and he ranked first in the imperial examination. It's normal to be selected as the top pick in the imperial examination." "Okay, I still care a little. Can you tell me what poems he wrote?" Tang Yi still felt that he needed to see what level Tang Hua was.What if the title of the Shenyuan Poetry Recital in a few days has nothing to do with the poems of those big guys in the previous life, and I won’t be able to copy them by then, then it’s nonsense.Di Cang looked at Emperor Yanwen, Your Majesty, please tell me, I don't know how to memorize it... "I usually ask you to read more books, but you still say that I am making things difficult for you." Emperor Yanwen glared at Di Cang, looked at Tang Yi and said: "The country is broken by mountains and rivers, the city is springy and the grass and trees are deep, feeling flowers splashing with tears, hating other birds that are frightened..." "Wait, you said this poem was written by a Tang painting?" Before Emperor Yanwen finished speaking, Tang Yi stood up in shock.My special mother!Is this "Spring Hope" by Du Fu?How did "Spring Hope" become the "Poetry of Admonition" painted in the Tang Dynasty?Could it be that this guy is also a time traveler?As soon as this idea came up, it was immediately rejected by Tang Yi himself.If the time traveler were still as pissed as Tang Hua, it would be a disgrace to the time traveler.Then this poem could only have been stolen by him.When he was called out by Liang Shao and the others last night, Tang Hua was in the courtyard, and at that time he happened to write down the song "Spring Hope" that he gave to the old prince.It must be that after they left, Tang Hua sneaked into the house and took the poem away.Then, this poem was used by Tang Hua as his own, and he won the first prize in the palace examination.Shameless!"How is it? Are you scared? Let me tell you, everyone was scared when we were in the main hall." Emperor Yanwen thought of the scene at that time, shook his head and said: "Those civil servants thought they had a spokesperson, and their laughter almost caused the Zizheng Palace to collapse." Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly.That's not what I meant. I wanted to say that Tang paintings were copied.I have given this poem to the old prince, and now it is exclusive to the old prince."Spring Hope"?Oh, when he left that day, the old prince even changed the name of the poem.The name is "Old Fu Wang Recalls the Shame of Jingkang".When Old King Fu came back from his inspection, his exclusive BGM was stolen. With the old man's character, he couldn't explode?I just don't know if he and Tang Yin will be implicated if things get serious.Tang Yi looked at Emperor Yanwen and wanted to tell the truth several times, but he still held back.Now that I say it, I feel jealous of the talented. Emperor Yan Wen and General Di are still debating whether they believe it or not. The key point is... even he copied it!It’s just that no one knows if he copied it.If Tang paintings are copied, big trouble will happen."Okay, Tang Yi, don't worry so much. The "Man Jiang Hong" and "Broken Array" you wrote are no less than the "Poems of Admonition"..." Emperor Yan Wen was afraid that Tang Yi would be confused, so he comforted him with a smile.As he finished speaking, the smile on his lips gradually faded."Let's not talk about it anymore. I have to tell you something, but don't get excited." "Tang Yin is injured, covered with bruises..." Bang!Before he finished speaking, Tang Yi stood up suddenly, and the chairs behind him were overturned to the ground.Hearing this movement, Chen Diaosi and Zhao Hu, who were guarding the door, broke through the door almost instantly, and both guarded Emperor Yanwen.The sword in Zhao Hu's hand was instantly unsheathed.At this time, Tang Yi's face was gloomy, his eyes were piercing, and the killing intent that filled his body had almost turned into reality.A cold and strong sense of oppression hit my face."Who did this? Isn't my sister in the Liang family?" Tang Yi's voice was cold to the bone.Emperor Yanwen and Di Cang were both shocked by Tang Yi's momentum at this time.This kind of momentum is usually only found in warriors who have fought in hundreds of battles.But now, they felt it from the young man in front of them.Where can a young man who has never left the mansion go to practice his murderous aura?"It was Tang Hao and Lin Zhu who did it. They took my jade pendant away with them. How brave they were..." Emperor Yan Wen also had a cold expression on his face. First he snatched away the banknote he gave Tang Yi, and then the jade pendant he gave Yinyin. The Tang family was really brave.If it weren't for his inability to interfere in the Tang family's internal affairs, and if it wasn't time to reveal his identity in front of Tang Yi, he would have to let the Tang family know the consequences of offending Tianwei!"Tang Yin is fine now. Concubine Xian was at the Liang family yesterday and took her back to the palace to take care of her." Emperor Yanwen waved Chen Diaosi and Zhao Hu away and said, "Go to the palace and wait. We will go back and have someone notify the palace and send Tang Yin out."That kid is very sensible and is trying his best to pretend that if you can't solve the problem, Concubine Xian will help you solve it."As for Yin'er, just pretend you don't know anything."Tang Yi's body trembled violently, and his heart felt like it was stabbed hard.There are traces!Last night, he clearly noticed that Tang Yin had lost her energy during the day and became timid and fearful.However, he thought it was because
